question: Within what period can one become a recipient of accomplishment through Kula knowledge?
premises: Engagement with Kula knowledge is the cause
A period of six months is specified
The result is becoming a recipient of accomplishment
inference: Through enjoyment of Kula knowledge, one becomes a recipient of accomplishment in six months
uncertainties: The term saṃbhoga may carry ritual or experiential nuances
plain_english: Through the enjoyment of Kula knowledge, one becomes a recipient of accomplishment in six months.
